outlook.statement: The company's business performance is directly related to the real-estate sector & infrastructure, which has slashed down due to sluggish product demand. The company has imported fresh raw materials during the financial year 2025-26 in which most of material are in transit and prefers to buy some finished materials from the domestic market to meet priority orders.

No significant CAPEX planned in near term; gearing up to export products to Middle Eastern countries from unit near Chennai Port; planning showroom in Delhi next year; commencing quarry operations in Odisha this quarter with commercial production shortly thereafter; discussions with Vietnam-based partner in final stages to boost revenue and profitability; expanding product offerings with budget-friendly Indian Granites and porcelain tiles; targeting Smart Cities in Uttar Pradesh and Jewar Airport vicinity demand.

Indian natural stone market projected to reach USD 5.91 billion by 2027 and USD 8.12 billion by 2032 (CAGR ~6.6%); India Real GDP growth 8.2% in 2025-26; Nominal GDP projected at Rs 360 lakh crore in 2026-27.
We plan to export 40% of our finished goods to the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
The Jewar Aerotropolis project will further elevate the area with advanced infrastructure, commercial hubs, and hospitality options.
Second mine in Odisha (Potru Village) projected to commence operations by July or August 2025, focusing on Jet Black Granite.
